conventions.convention: Natural units c = ℏ = 1 and Minkowski signature diag(-,+,+,+); logarithmic RG time is t = log(μ/μ₀).
Wilson coefficients are dimensionless columns; complex coefficient spaces are realified by interleaving real and imaginary components. Matching derivatives are real derivatives.
Matching equality concerns selected outputs after the supplied retained-order projections, using a common infrared regulator. It supplies no discarded-term estimate.
RG compatibility is an additional exact identity for the supplied finite-order maps; amplitude matching alone does not imply it. Interval-wide flow existence is separately assumed.
Wilsonian, renormalization, threshold, external-energy, regulator, and operator-suppression scales are distinct unless additional model inputs identify them.

The QED DS beta equation uses differentiation with respect to log(μ²): dα/ dlog(μ²) = nα²/(3π). Couplings are continuous at the muon threshold and αDS(mₑ) = αphys; evaluation domains exclude reciprocal-coupling zeros.

load_bearing.statement: A matching map is RG-compatible when ∂t M̂t(x) + Dx M̂t(x) β+(t,x) = β−(t,M̂t(x)) for every admitted pair. Matching itself requires equality of the selected projected high- and low-energy outputs at the common infrared regulator.

Under the stated continuity, locally uniform state-Lipschitz, joint C¹ matching, RG-compatibility, trajectory-domain, and interval-wide flow-existence hypotheses, Φ−(tf,s)(M̂s(Φ+(s,ti)xi)) is independent of s in K. Selected final outputs consequently are independent of the intermediate matching scale through the retained orders; the conclusion extends to finite compatible threshold sequences with the required flows.
